games.name: [🩹🐛] Die of Death
games.desc:
Earlier update log: Fashionably Late Update. This update includes tons of new major content and reworks. Nearly everything in the game has been changed up to some extent, check it out!
UPDATE LOG: A small bit of content and a TON of bug fixes and rebalancings. This is the most bug fixes Die of Death has gotten in any update ever! Intention behind this patch is to fix up the game back to its glory again.

Die of Death is a notably inconsistent game when it comes to strategy and often requires adapting on the fly to win. This game does an unique spin on the asymmetrical-horror genre, taking a more light and unserious tone when it comes to its content & gameplay! Randomness is a key factor here, with gamemodes that appear in between matches, random ability decks survivors are forced to pick in order to live, and more!

NOTHING IN THIS GAME FINAL, EXPECT CHANGES IN THE FUTURE!

Thumbnail & game icon both by @Chiprit103!

games.name: 💥 BUCKSHOT
games.desc:
Loaded shotgun. Mixed shells. Your move.

Take turns with a shotgun loaded with lives and blanks. Shoot your rival, or risk a blank to keep the turn. Count every shell that's spent, play the odds, and lie to their face.

🔫 Duels and brawls
Tense 1v1 duels or 4-player tables where nobody trusts anybody.

🎒 Items
Peek shells, rack one out, handcuff rivals, heal, invert a shell, or steal what they were saving. Every item flips the round.

🏆 Ranked
Climb from placements to the top of the ladder. Seasonal ranks, exclusive titles, and a global top 100.

🎨 Skins and titles
Win cash, open cases, unbox skins from Common to Contraband and beyond. Rare drops roll a TrakStat module that counts your kills. Collect animated titles, level up, clear daily quests.

💱 Trading
Trade skins and titles with anyone, or hit the Trading Hub to hunt for limiteds. Some guns only exist in the double digits.

👍 Like the game and join our group for a free Deluxe Case + cash.

games.name: [将] Shogun's Reign
games.desc:
⚔️ [将] SHOGUN'S REIGN 🏯

From the fields to the throne, your destiny is yours to claim.

Welcome to [将] Shogun's Reign, a roleplaying and progression experience inspired by the world of Edo-period Japan. This game contains fantasy elements and is not intended to be historically accurate.

🌾 Work the fields. Earn your first Ryō through farming, labor, and humble trades.

🏮 Find your place. Explore bustling towns, mountain villages, shrines, estates, and the dangerous roads that connect them.

⚔️ Rise through society. Build your wealth and reputation, master a profession, serve those above you, or take a more dangerous path toward power.

🏯 Climb the ranks. Become a respected warrior, influential noble, or powerful feudal lord as you compete with others for status and authority.

👑 Claim the Shogunate. At the very top stands one position above all others: Shogun. Gain enough influence, wealth, and power, and the realm itself may one day fall under your rule.
